en: Colorized historical postcard showing a two-story building with a richly patterned red-and-white tiled roof and a central arched entrance. The façade is light-colored with rectangular windows, and several men in early 20th‑century clothing stand in front of the building. To the right, part of a church tower with a clock is visible. Hungarian text appears at the top and above the entrance.
